architecture_pattern.name: MVC / Layered Architecture
architecture_pattern.description: A simple layered pattern where the frontend SPA talks to an Express REST API, which separates routing, business logic, and data access into distinct layers. Appropriate for a single-user CRUD app with no complex domain logic.

components.name: Frontend (Vue 3 SPA)
components.role: Renders task list, handles user interactions, communicates with the REST API

components.name: API Controller (Express routes)
components.role: Receives HTTP requests, delegates to service layer, returns responses

components.name: Service Layer
components.role: Business logic for task CRUD, filtering by status, and sorting by due date

nfr.requirement: API responses and page loads under 1 second for all task operations
No authentication required; API should only be accessible from localhost or trusted local network
Single-user — no scalability requirements for this version
Best-effort; no formal uptime SLA for personal use

architecture_notes: SQLite is chosen over PostgreSQL/MySQL to eliminate the need for a separate database server process on self-hosted deployment — appropriate given single-user scale. Prisma is chosen as the ORM for its type-safe query API and built-in migration tooling (Prisma Migrate), reducing setup friction. Jest + Supertest covers both unit and HTTP integration tests for the Express API.
